item.title: Iran's intelligence minister Esmail Khatib killed in air strike
item.summary: Israel said it had killed Khatib, whose death was confirmed by Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on Wednesday.

item.title: Oil nears $110 a barrel after gas field strike
item.summary: Iran's military warned it would take "decisive action" in response to the strike on its energy infrastructure.

item.title: Top US counterterrorism official resigns over Iran war, urging Trump to 'reverse course'
item.summary: National Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent says Trump "started this war due to pressure from Israel and its powerful American lobby".

item.title: 'Very difficult to stop': BBC visits scene of Iran cluster bomb strike on Israel
item.summary: An elderly couple was killed after a bomb flew into their apartment in central Israel and exploded.

item.title: Total repression and air strikes bring unrelenting dread for Iranians
item.summary: Tehran residents tell the BBC they're caught between US-Israeli bombing and an Iranian regime trying to reassert its power.

item.title: Death of Ali Larijani deepens crisis at heart of Iran's leadership
item.summary: Larijani has long been seen as one of the Islamic Republic's most experienced and influential policy makers.

item.title: Israel destroys river bridges in southern Lebanon
item.summary: The health ministry says that 968 people, including more than 100 children, have been killed since 2 March.

item.title: Quantum pioneers win Turing Award for encryption breakthrough
item.summary: It is hoped Charles H Bennett and Gilles Brassard's work will make digital communications secure for decades ahead.

item.title: Italy warns Russian tanker could explode in Mediterranean at any time
item.summary: Italy is one of nine EU countries urging the European Commission to act over the Arctic Metagaz, drifting out of control in the Mediterranean Sea.

item.title: One killed as ski gondola crashes down mountain at Swiss resort
item.summary: Dramatic footage showed the gondola flipping over several times in the snow before coming to a halt in Engelberg.
